newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor sees more mineral rights swaps.
newsitem.headline: Gencor sees more mineral rights swaps.

text.p: Last week's mineral rights swap between Anglo American Corp of South Africa and Gencor Ltd could be the first of many such deals, Gengold managing director Tom Dale said on Monday.

"This has only been possible because there is a fresh wind blowing in the industry and I think this is the start of things in the future. I would expect this kind of thing to accelerate," he said at the December quarter presentation.
The Anglo/Gencor swap is expected to open up an additional 230 tonnes of gold for both parties.

At the time of the announcement, analysts said that the rationalisation of mineral rights, which have been gathered since the heady days of South Africa's gold rush more than a century ago, amounted to good business sense.
